description: disable kubernetes-manager updates of the vendored flux toolkit manifest. The flux manager
legitimately updates fluxcd/flux2 via this file, so this rule must stay scoped to
matchManagers: [kubernetes] -- an unscoped enabled:false here would stop flux2 upgrades of
clusterops-core entirely. This records the intent behind the kubernetes.ignorePaths entry in
renovate.json and keeps the exclusion effective if that override is ever removed. The two
are not redundant in effect: ignorePaths stops the kubernetes manager EXTRACTING the file
(its 27 deps -- 4 docker, 23 kubernetes-api -- never reach the dependency dashboard),
while this rule only stops updates on deps that were extracted. Historical note: that
manager-level ignorePaths override (non-mergeable) used to be the only reason the
kubernetes manager scanned ci/test/** at all, because ':ignoreModulesAndTests' ignored
'**/test/**' globally. That preset has since been dropped from renovate.json's extends
(fixture drift), so nothing ignores test paths for any manager now.
